source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original observer rebuild always assigns this.value from this.#cachedValue after cloning options. The field has no initializer, and the first setup path has not cached a selection yet. This can supply an unset value even when a cloned option carries selected. Fixed accepted code checks whether the rebuilt options contain a selection before restoring the cache. This static phase difference is separate from the later backout cause and has no reproduced UI result.
title: The first Account Hub option observer restores an unset cache during initial rebuild
